scope: Static analysis of publicly served frontend JavaScript. No authenticated API calls.
offsetConvention: Zero-based Unicode character offsets in the decoded source, not byte offsets.
extractionLimits: Only quoted /api/ strings are collected. Computed routes can be missed.
Query strings are removed from path keys. A key can be a path prefix.
Methods are recorded only for direct .get/.post/etc calls with a literal first argument. Calls through variables need manual analysis.
HTTP method alone does not indicate whether an operation mutates state.
Sources can contain legacy or unreachable code. Entries are candidates, not confirmed backend contracts.
